title: Spring Rolls with Zesty Dipping Sauce
description: A refreshing twist on traditional spring rolls, served with a zesty dipping sauce. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Prepare the zesty dipping sauce by mixing the monsoon mango chutney and vegetable oil in a bowl.
Place the spring rolls on a plate and brush with the egg wash.
Heat the vegetable oil in the preheated pan and fry the spring rolls until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain the spring rolls on paper towels and serve hot with the zesty dipping sauce.
Garnish with Dutch processed cacao powder and a sprinkle of salt and black pepper.
